aboutSection.desc: AEGRYN builds proprietary tech assets, certifies them under an independent co-signed label, and transacts them through a confidential process between qualified sellers and institutional buyers. The first trust infrastructure for tech M&A in Europe.
aboutSection.tagline: CERTIFIED IN SWITZERLAND. REFERENCE IN EUROPE.

items.title: BUILD
items.desc: We build proprietary tech assets designed from inception to be certifiable and transferable — SaaS, marketplaces, AI protocols. Each asset is structured to withstand the most rigorous audit.

items.title: GRADE
items.desc: We certify third-party and proprietary assets under an independent A→E label, co-signed by legal, financial and cybersecurity experts who stake their professional liability. KRYV Protocol blockchain-certifies the code at every transfer.

items.title: AUCTION
items.desc: We transact certified assets through a confidential process — institutional escrow, circle of pre-qualified buyers, 60-day exclusive mandate. Less than 25% of submitted assets are accepted.

items.title: CO-SIGNED CERTIFICATION
items.desc: Every AEGRYN grade report is co-signed by a law firm, an accountant and a cybersecurity partner. They stake their liability. Not an opinion — a certification.

items.title: BLOCKCHAIN AT TRANSFER
items.desc: KRYV Protocol records the exact cryptographic fingerprint of the codebase at the signing date. What you receive is provable at any future date. Immutable by design.

items.title: INSTITUTIONAL ESCROW
items.desc: 10% of the transaction price is deposited in a bank escrow account upon signing the Heads of Terms. The seller is protected. The buyer is committed. AEGRYN never touches the funds.

items.title: CLOSED CIRCLE
items.desc: No asset is publicly visible before passing the grade. No buyer accesses the catalogue without proof of capacity. Discretion is structural, not optional.

items.title: EUROPEAN REFERENCE
items.desc: Anchored in Switzerland, operating across Europe. Our transaction sessions, quarterly market report, and historical catalogue build the standard the European tech M&A market has been waiting for.

methodology.label: Methodology
methodology.title:
A reproducible protocol.
Not a subjective opinion.
methodology.desc: The AEGRYN Grade methodology is documented, versioned and audited. Every analyst follows the same protocol.

principles.title: Reproducibility
principles.desc: Two independent analysts applying the same protocol must reach the same grade within ±1 sub-code.

principles.title: Traceability
principles.desc: Every grade is digitally signed and blockchain-anchored. Any revision generates a new traceable version.

principles.title: Independence
principles.desc: Analysts have no financial interest in the assets they certify. Strict separation between certification and transaction.

principles.title: Revisability
principles.desc: A grade can be revised after documented improvement. The original grade remains visible in the history.

methodology.scoringDesc: Each dimension is scored 0–25 points. The total determines the grade according to a published table.

meta.title: AEGRYN Bid Models — Club Deal, Corporate, Funds
meta.desc: Three bid models to acquire a certified AEGRYN tech asset: individual with co-investors, corporate, or investment fund.

hero.label: AEGRYN AUCTION — BID MODELS
hero.title:
Three ways to acquire
a certified asset.
hero.desc: AEGRYN structures three bid models adapted to each buyer profile — from individuals with co-investors to institutional funds. Each model includes an escrow mechanism and a certified Transaction Promise.

model1.label: MODEL 01
model1.title:
Club Deal
(Individual + co-investors)
model1.desc: A lead bidder can associate up to 4 declared co-investors. One offer, one escrow paid by the lead. Internal allocation remains confidential to AEGRYN.
features: Escrow paid by the lead bidder
Full lead KYC + simplified co-investor KYC

model2.label: MODEL 02
model2.title:
Corporate
(Company or Holding)
model2.desc: A legal entity acquires the asset directly on its balance sheet. Co-bid possible between two entities in a declared JV. Asset deal or share deal depending on the structure.
features: Asset deal or share deal available
Full B2B KYC (company registration, articles, UBO)

model3.label: MODEL 03
model3.title:
Fund
(PE · VC · Family Office)
model3.badge: PE · VC · Family Office · Search Fund
model3.desc: Institutional funds benefit from an IC (Investment Committee) period of 5 to 10 days before submitting a firm offer. SPV available for direct LP co-investment.
features: IC period of 5–10 business days granted
Institutional KYC (authorisation, prospectus, significant GP + LP)

escrow.label: COMMON MECHANISM
escrow.title:
The Transaction Promise
with institutional escrow.
escrow.desc: Regardless of the bid model, every AEGRYN transaction relies on our PTT mechanism:

steps.title: Expression of Interest
steps.desc: Non-binding. Transmitted to seller within 48h. No deposit required.

steps.title: Agreement in Principle
steps.desc: Price and structure agreed. Signing the AP triggers the escrow obligation.

steps.title: 10% Escrow
steps.desc: Paid into a third-party bank account within 5 business days. AEGRYN never has access to the funds.

steps.title: Due Diligence — 30 days
steps.desc: Full data room access. Q&A via AEGRYN. Extensions possible by mutual agreement.

steps.title: Signing & Closing
steps.desc: Blockchain certification of the exact code state. Funds released. Asset transferred.

escrow.penaltyBuyer: Buyer withdrawal without cause → escrow acquired by seller
escrow.penaltySeller: Seller withdrawal without cause → escrow returned doubled to buyer
escrow.penaltyCs: Condition precedent lifted → escrow fully refunded (no fault)

hero.title:
Estimate the value
of your asset.
hero.desc: Our calculator simulates the AEGRYN grade protocol across 4 dimensions — Finance, Code, IP, Security — and gives you a valuation range calibrated on 2026 market multiples. Free. Confidential. No commitment.

weakMessages.finance: Your Finance score is the weakest. An audited ARR and NRR > 100% are the highest-impact levers.
weakMessages.code: Your Code dimension limits your grade. Adding automated tests and CI/CD can gain 8 to 10 points.
weakMessages.ip: Your IP is not yet secured. This is the #1 factor limiting your grade — a filed trademark alone is worth +8 points.
weakMessages.security: No recent pentest. Institutional buyers require a report < 12 months old. This is a frequent blocker in due diligence.

strongMessages.finance: Your financial metrics are strong. Excellent signal for buyers.
strongMessages.code: Your codebase is well-maintained. Strong maintainability signal for buyers.
strongMessages.ip: Your intellectual property is properly secured. Good asset protection signal.
strongMessages.security: Recent pentest and GDPR compliance in order. Excellent signal for institutional buyers.

result.preRevenueDesc: Without ARR, valuation is based on your combined IP and Code score. The indicative range reflects the raw asset value.
result.preRevenueNote: For a pre-revenue asset, AEGRYN Grade C is the natural next step. It values IP and code before any transaction.
result.ngNote: Your current score is below the gradability threshold. A free Assessment Day will help identify the 3 priority actions.
result.disclaimer: This estimate is generated by an algorithm from data you declare without verification. It does not constitute an official AEGRYN Grade. The AEGRYN Grade is only awarded after a real audit by our teams and co-signing partners (legal firm, accountant, cybersecurity partner).
result.emailTitle: Receive my detailed report by email.
result.emailDesc: Detailed score by dimension, full range, and the 3 priority actions to improve your grade.
